name: whossy-rules-tests
description: Emulator tests for firestore.rules/storage.rules (A6) and the notification + presence Cloud Function triggers (B2, C1). Requires Java for the emulators.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:triggers
scripts.test:triggers: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project whossy-app --only firestore,functions,database "node --test --test-concurrency=1 notifications.test.js presence.test.js popularity.test.js pagination.test.js"
